articles.t: Vue à la première personne GTA 6 : comment activer la vue FPS ?
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 est un jeu qui se joue à la troisième personne, sans surprise. Mais une partie du public aimerait savoir comment le jeu se déroulerait si [...]
articles.txt:
GTA 6 est un jeu qui se joue à la troisième personne, sans surprise. Mais une partie du public aimerait savoir comment le jeu se déroulerait si l’on changeait de caméra. Est-ce possible de le faire dans GTA 6 ? La réponse est compliquée.
Existe-t-il un mode à la première personne (vue FPS) dans GTA 6 ? La question se pose, mais techniquement, Rockstar n’a pas donné la possibilité de jouer à GTA 6 en vue à la première personne de manière officielle. Certaines actions vous donnent temporairement accès à cette caméra, comme lorsque vous conduisez et que vous consultez votre téléphone. Vous verrez d’ailleurs qu’il est bien difficile de conduire droit en faisant deux choses en même temps (un beau message de prévention). Mais ça, c’est sur le papier. Quelques petits malins ont trouvé un moyen pour jouer à GTA 6 en vue à la première personne en profitant d’un petit bug qui est disponible au lancement du jeu.
Pour en profiter, il faut d’abord vous rendre dans vos Paramètres, puis dans l’onglet « Manette » . Descendez jusqu’à la 18ᵉ option afin de remplacer l’action de votre pavé tactile. Au lieu d’afficher la carte, il agira cette fois-ci sur la caméra en l’activant .
Le paramètre à modifier pour activer le bug de la vue à la première personne dans GTA 6 // Source : ActuGaming
Une fois ce paramètre réglé, entrez dans une voiture et sortez votre portable avec la flèche du haut. Puis, appuyez sur Rond/B, et directement sur le pavé tactile plusieurs fois pour activer le glitch de la vue à la première personne dans GTA 6 .
Avec un peu de chance, le bug va s’activer (chez nous, ça a marché comme vous pouvez le voir ci-dessus), et votre vue restera à la première personne, même en sortant de véhicule. Vous pouvez alors vous balader, braquer des banques et faire tout ce que vous voulez, sans que cette vue ne change. C’est toujours ça de pris en attendant que Rockstar implémente un mode FPS plus officiel, en espérant que le bug ne soit pas supprimé lors d’une mise à jour.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Justice recrute Joe Keery (Stranger Things) pour la bande originale - Eklecty-City
articles.chapeau: Joe Keery (Stranger Things) rejoint Justice sous son nom Djo sur The Night’s Coming, un morceau de la bande originale de GTA 6.
articles.txt:
Déjà très orientée vers la scène électronique française depuis le lancement de Grand Theft Auto VI, la bande-son du jeu accueille un invité venu des séries américaines : Joe Keery, alias Steve Harrington dans Stranger Things, qui pose sa voix sous son nom de scène Djo sur le morceau The Night’s Coming produit par Justice.
Après Daft Punk sur les ondes de Flash FM avec Around the World , Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo à la production du single RHYNO de Travis Scott et Étienne de Crécy aux côtés de Fred again.. et PinkPantheress sur Sexy Magic , le duo français Justice poursuit l’assemblage de sa bande originale pour Grand Theft Auto VI en se tournant cette fois vers la pop psychédélique américaine . Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay invitent ainsi Joe Keery , l’interprète de Steve Harrington dans Stranger Things , sur un morceau inédit.
Sous son pseudonyme musical Djo , l’acteur accompagne les deux producteurs sur The Night’s Coming , un titre intégré à Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score , attendu pour le 11 décembre 2026 . Les paroles du morceau installent une atmosphère nocturne et mélancolique, portée par le regret, le souvenir d’une disparition qu’il est impossible de ramener à la vie et l’obsession d’un vieux cœur qui bat au rythme d’une voix qui se répète.
Si le grand public associe d’abord Joe Keery à ses apparitions dans Stranger Things , Free Guy ou encore la cinquième saison de Fargo , l’Américain mène une carrière musicale parallèle depuis plus d’une décennie. Co-fondateur, batteur, guitariste et chanteur du groupe de rock psychédélique Post Animal entre 2014 et 2018, il avait quitté la formation en raison de son emploi du temps sur les plateaux de tournage afin d’éviter que l’image de son personnage dans la série de Netflix ne colle trop à l’identité du groupe.
Il lance alors son aventure solo sous le nom de Djo en 2019 avec le single Roddy et l’album Twenty Twenty . Son deuxième disque, Decide , sorti en 2022, lui vaut une reconnaissance internationale en 2024 grâce au succès viral sur TikTok du morceau End of Beginning , qui lui permet d’entrer pour la première fois dans le classement Billboard Hot 100. En 2025, il enchaîne avec un troisième album, The Crux – dont la pochette décroche une nomination aux Grammy Awards 2026 – suivi de son compagnon The Crux Deluxe , avant de réintégrer Post Animal pour l’album Iron et d’assurer leur première partie lors de sa tournée mondiale Back on You . Un itinéraire qui l’a aussi amené à coécrire le titre Funny Mouth pour la bande originale du film Wuthering Heights signée Charli XCX en 2026, et à rejoindre Tame Impala sur la première partie de la tournée Deadbeat cette même année.
Ce partenariat avec Djo s’inscrit dans la séparation opérée par Rockstar Games entre les deux disques officiels de GTA 6 . D’un côté, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , sorti le 19 novembre 2026 chez Atlantic Records en même temps que le jeu vidéo, rassemble 34 chansons originales créées pour l’univers de Vice City et de l’État de Leonida, parmi lesquelles le single Flower in a Hurricane réunissant déjà Justice , SZA , Tame Impala et King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard .
De l’autre, Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score , attendu le 11 décembre 2026 en streaming, CD et vinyle, regroupe 30 compositions écrites par Gaspard Augé et Xavier de Rosnay pour accompagner dynamiquement l’exploration et les séquences d’action de Jason et Lucia. C’est au sein de ce second disque, où l’on retrouve également le morceau dark techno Pusher conçu avec Gesaffelstein , que prend place The Night’s Coming avec Joe Keery , confirmant la volonté de Justice d’ouvrir sa partition électronique à des voix issues de la scène psychédélique actuelle.
Votre soutien est important pour Eklecty-City, retrouvez toutes les actualités pop culture sur les réseaux sociaux : Facebook , BlueSky , Instagram , Twitter .

articles.t: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
articles.chapeau: In briefGTA 6 leaker Cyberleek released what it claims is a near-complete 209 GB Xbox build via torrent but is holding back the main executable until its meme coin reaches a $15 million
articles.txt:
A notorious Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker is holding a potential PC version of the game hostage to a cryptocurrency payday, promising to release the final file needed to make a leaked build playable once its meme coin hits a $15 million market cap.
The leaker, who goes by Cyberleek, has released what it claims is a near-complete 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6 from November 2026 via torrent, according to a report from PC Gamer .
The one piece withheld is the main executable, the file that would let modders begin emulating the game on PC, potentially bringing it to the platform long before Rockstar Games intends.
You can now act on the news you read: Go long or short Bitcoin with perpetual futures, all from your Decrypt Money Account.
Here’s the crypto catch. Cyberleek says it will release the executable on Nov. 23 regardless, but will drop it early if its token, called CYBERLEEK, reaches a $15 million market cap. That’s half the $30 million target the leaker floated in October.
The pressure tactic doesn’t appear to be working: the token is trading around $0.002 as of the weekend, with a market cap of roughly $1.3 million, more than $13 million short of the goal. The coin is down some 20% on the week, but the numbers will fluctuate wildly given the very thin liquidity on a small cap coin.
The setup has drawn open skepticism that it’s a cash grab, or worse. Observers have warned it could be an attempt to pump the coin before a rug pull, the crypto term for abandoning a token after luring buyers in. Cyberleek has also claimed to hold a PS5 build as a fallback if the Xbox files can’t be made to work.
The episode sits at the increasingly busy intersection of crypto, piracy, and AI. Modern Xbox games are architecturally closer to PC software than PlayStation titles, and AI coding tools have accelerated the kind of decompilation work that makes fast ports plausible, the same dynamic behind a wave of AI-assisted game ports this year.
It also caps a chaotic launch window for GTA that crypto has repeatedly crashed. One trader banked around $66,000 on a GTA 6 meme coin amid ticker confusion, and the game’s disc-free, digital-only release has fueled broader debate, with GameStop’s CEO arguing that digital-only games have hurt consumers.
None of the leaked files have been independently confirmed as genuine, and there is still no official GTA 6 PC version; Rockstar, famously litigious, could respond with legal action rather than a port.

articles.t: GTA 6 gets its first 'Mount Chilliad'-esque mystery and I'm already losing sleep over it
articles.chapeau: We need to know what this is about...
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is rife with mysteries that are keeping us up at night...
Grand Theft Auto VI is officially out in the wild, and after rave reviews it’s safe to say Rockstar Games delivered exactly what we wanted.
GAMINGbible gave GTA VI a glowing 10/10 review and even got a few words from Rockstar’s co-lead Rob Nelson to tell us more about its open-world design, and what was learned from Red Dead Redemption 2 .
Rockstar has crafted one of the most realistic video game worlds we’ve ever seen, but that’s not to say the more goofy elements from Grand Theft Auto V aren’t still weaved into its code.
During my 70+ hours with the game I stumbled upon a dark mystery that needs to be solved…before I go insane thinking about it.
Leaving the hustle and bustle of Vice City behind, some of my exploration in GTA VI took me out into the wilderness.
To tell the truth, when I initially saw the dense foliage and mountains I worried Rockstar Games had repeated the sins of the past. GTA V ’s Blaine County was pretty plain and boring, but Mount Chiliad always stood out through more than just its size.
While there are no mysteries to GTA VI’s mountains (that I know of) the area surrounding them is rife with secrets.
Near the gold mines, you’ll find some man-made tunnels and caves lying dormant. They’re not much to look at, but one in particular felt very Until Dawn -coded.
You can find the cave on the map point below, and when you reach it, walk all the way down to the end of the tunnel till you reach the bend. Make sure the flashlight is equipped as it gets very dark in there.
On the wall you’ll spot a trailer of blood leading upwards to an inaccessible platform. Far above it is an opening that leads to the surface, and while you find it above it’s not a safe way down. If you drop through the hole you won’t survive the fall.
Since discovering this though I’ve been desperate to find out what’s up there, and what could have left that blood trail.
My first thought was some sort of bear or other wild animal, but knowing Rockstar’s love of the occult it wouldn’t surprise me to learn skinwalkers could be found in the game.
I’ve tried driving a pick-up truck down the tunnel to see if I could climb atop and scale my way up from there, but even that’s not enough. I’ll pile up as many vehciles as I have to though, and the only reason I haven’t done it already is because everytime I go to get said vehicles something else distracts me.
Even more magical is knowing this is just one of many secrets found in GTA VI . We’re going ot be scouring Leonida for months.

articles.t: Giant crab safe code and Crabshack VF5 SMG location in GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Karkinos cannot be contained. Karkinos is free
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has a giant crab haunting the swamps and, more importantly, the Crabshack VF5 SMG , a crab-themed gun, to help your future career prospects. It's all part of an optional event called Pelican Valley Outpost that sees you pick up the pieces of some questionable experiments carried out on behalf of a store chain. It's worth the trouble, even aside from the standout weapon. There's some cash to help reach your next family fund milestone and a free jet ski, too. Best of all, this little excursion is completely safe, assuming you don't run afoul of the local gator population.
Below, we show you where to find the giant crab in GTA 6 so you can clear the Pelican Valley Outpost and get the Crabshack VF5 SMG .
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon Pelican Valley Outpost, where the giant crab research facility is, has several codes you need to find on your way to getting the standout weapon. You'll find it on a medium-sized island southwest of the "Pelican Valley" name label on the map. Once you remove the fog from the region map, you can see it's one of the only islands in the area with buildings on it.
Take Jason's boat from his house, and set out. Definitely don't swim here, even if you're already nearby. There are too many gators for this to be a safe option. You can dock your boat at the boathouse and follow the jetty to the research facility proper. The boathouse is locked, but you'll get inside before leaving.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon You'll see several buildings in the compound, but if you venture inside the first shack, you'll notice the power is off. You can still explore it, though you can't access the researcher's computer, which is essential for clearing the outpost. Head outside and around the back of the building near the blue crab cages. Interact with the breaker box to turn the power on, and head back inside. Ignore the computer for now, and take a right. There's a bag of chips in the kitchen if you want Jason to pack on some calories, and the login password for the computer is in the small bedroom opposite the kitchen . Investigate the small piece of wood on the floor to see all the choices, with " CLEAVES " being the most recent.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon Interact with the computer, and press left on the direction pad to enter CLEAVES. You can skim through a few tabs of information on-screen, but the important one is the note in the green cell that says " Safe code = Double Success ." Leave when you're finished.
Karkinos, the giant crab from the report, will jump you in a short cutscene, but you don't have to fight her. Press the on-screen button to push her off, and she'll vanish into the swamp.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon If you want to get the giant crab safe code yourself, head to the research lab behind the shack next. There's a table with a trauma kit and some Zombix inside, which is handy, and in the specimen room you'll find Karkinos' former home and a list of experiments. Only one was a success, number 36. The code, "double success," refers to doubling the number of the successful experiment, making the code 0072 .
Go back into the shack, and enter 0072 on the safe. Inside, you'll find a stack of money ($1,107 for us) and another note that reads " Emergency go protocol: 0212 ."
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon The emergency protocol is the boathouse code. Leave the research compound, return to the boathouse, and input 0212 on the keypad . The door will open. Karkinos' caretaker wasn't as lucky as Jason, but their loss is your gain. Pick up the Crabshack VF5 SMG from their corpse, and you can grab a bag of marked bills to drop off at Brian's lockup later, too.
You can leave the compound the way you came, or you can hop on the jet ski and make your way home that way.

articles.t: GTA 6 Players Report Frequent Crashes on PS5 and Pro Consoles, Say Error CE-108255-1 Is Blocking Them From Progressing the Story
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 players on PlayStation 5 have reported frequent crashes tied to error code CE-108255-1, and it looks like it's blocking them from progressing through the story while they wait for Sony and Rockstar to send out a fix.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 players on PlayStation 5 have reported frequent crashes tied to error code CE-108255-1, and it looks like it's blocking them from progressing through the story while they wait for Sony and Rockstar to send out a fix.
Although Rockstar Games spent a decade making its new Grand Theft Auto game, it's no surprise to see the new highest-rated game of all time launching with at least a few hiccups. Some have it worse than others, though, with more than a few reports of crashes affecting PS5 consoles popping up online in the days following GTA 6's launch.
The most common cause seems to be tied to error code CE-108255-1, which, as defined by Sony , simply indicates that "an error occurred with the game/application." It seems that, although the majority of players aren't encountering the issue, those who have haven't been able to find a proper fix. Adding to the trouble is that those who have met these dreaded GTA 6 crashes are getting them pretty frequently, and what's triggering them isn't always clear. There are reports from players on both standard PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles running into these issues, with some even saying that crashes appear to be tied to the story, barring them from making any progress.
"I've noticed that the issue manifests differently for different players," one Reddit user said . "In my case, the game crashes on Jason's loading screen: it freezes and then displays the CE-108255-1 error code, meaning I can't even get into the game. Others manage to play for a few minutes before experiencing a crash. I really hope Sony and Rockstar work together to investigate and resolve this issue as soon as possible."
Game crashes are annoying for anyone, but when a massive game like GTA 6, which many feel has a less-than-generous autosave system , suddenly boots players back to the PS5 home screen without warning, it can be especially troublesome. Many who have reported the crashes to PlayStation Support say they've been directed to Rockstar, while those who report to Rockstar say they're being directed to PlayStation. One player said they feel like they're "stuck in an endless support loop, with a game I paid for and still can't play."
Meanwhile, those who have managed to get help say most assistance hasn't been able to completely resolve their issues. However, some have said they've had luck with a few tried-and-true methods, such as uninstalling and reinstalling the game, making sure both the PS5 and game have their most recent updates, and restoring licenses.
"I’ve done everything possible to solve this," another player said . "Deleted cache. Rebuilt database, deleted everything else from my console, took it apart, cleaned it, turned HDR off, switched to 1080p, went and updated game license, deleted and reinstalled and still crashing. Ugh. I’ve got a day 1 PS5 with a disc drive. Other friends of mine with the same console are playing with no issue."
Again, it's unclear if the crashing issue is tied specifically to the PS5 or GTA 6 itself. Until either entity comes up with an update, though, all affected players are stuck on launch weekend.
GTA 6 released for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19 and, in its first 24 hours, made Rockstar $3.79 billion. It's the most successful launch in the history of entertainment , and although its exact unit sales have yet to be disclosed, parent company Take-Two Interactive was at least willing to share that it sold 32.5 million copies in pre-orders alone.
For more, you can read about the players unhappy with how Rockstar handled Jason's secret stash . You can also see the lengths the developers went to in order to create realistic NPCs , as well as the Neuralink user who spent launch driving around Leonida with his mind .

articles.chapeau: L’équipe d’animation d’une résidence pour personnes âgées de Serris, en Seine-et-Marne, a fait essayer le jeu vidéo phénomène aux habitants.
articles.txt:
Les gangsters ont du souci à se faire : la concurrence arrive ! Une résidence pour seniors de Serris, en Seine-et-Marne, a proposé à ses habitants de s’essayer à GTA VI , ont rapporté Le Parisien et ICI Paris-Île-de-France. Le jeu qui permet d’incarner des criminels arpentant les rues de « Vice City » et sa sortie – très attendue – cette semaine a été commentée et suivie jusque dans la sphère politique .
Si les seniors ne sont pas forcément le cœur de cible, les retraités de cette résidence seine-et-marnaise ont semblé conquis par le jeu, qui a aussi été encensé par la presse spécialisée . « C’est le top du top » , a complimenté Lucienne, 86 ans, bluffée par le graphisme qui lui fait penser à « un vrai film » . « Je vais demander ça à mes enfants pour Noël » , a déclaré l’octogénaire citée par Le Parisien , qui ne connaissait pas du tout le jeu avant de l’essayer.
La brutalité de GTA VI, elle aussi très commentée, a-t-elle gêné ces seniors ? « Ils étaient entre deux sentiments » , a affirmé Karine Gomes, responsable de l’animation interrogée par ICI, dont vous pouvez visionner la vidéo ci-dessous . S’ils ont été interpellés par le fait que le jeu est « assez violent » , les retraités ont aussi été pris dans l’histoire et touchés par les difficultés de certains personnages. « C’était très marrant » à voir, a-t-elle glissé, expliquant vouloir proposer de nouvelles expériences aux habitants de la résidence.
La lecture de ce contenu est susceptible d’entraîner un dépôt de cookies de la part de l’opérateur tiers qui l’héberge. Compte-tenu des choix que vous avez exprimés en matière de dépôt de cookies, nous avons bloqué l’affichage de ce contenu. Si vous souhaitez y accéder, vous devez accepter la catégorie de cookies “Contenus tiers” en cliquant sur le bouton ci-dessous.
Certains des gangsters en herbe étaient même fiers de leur progrès, à l’image de Jacqueline, interrogée dans la vidéo d’ICI Paris. « Je n’avais jamais touché à une manette avant ce matin 9 heures et à 14h30, je pêchais deux paquets de drogue ! » , a résumé la femme de 82 ans, qui assure que GTA VI l’a « coupée de [sa] vie présente » et lui a « fait un bien inouï » .
L’histoire ne dit pas si les participants à l’animation vont vraiment poursuivre leur expérience de « gamers » . Une chose est sûre : leurs aventures sur GTA VI ont beaucoup touché et amusé les internautes, qui ont été plus de 1,3 million à visionner la vidéo d’ICI publiée sur X. « Ils sont super cools » , salue un commentaire, tandis qu’un autre félicite une « très belle initiative » … et s’amuse d’imaginer « les enfants qui vont devoir acheter [console] + GTA à mamie pour Noël » .

articles.chapeau: Avec les derniers événements dans GTA 6, le véhicule de Jason a besoin d’un sérieux passage au garage. Direction Coastal Auto Care pour [...]
articles.txt:
Avec les derniers événements dans GTA 6 , le véhicule de Jason a besoin d’un sérieux passage au garage. Direction Coastal Auto Care pour retrouver Joey et remettre la Ganado en état avant de reprendre la route. Un petit aparté qui pourrait bien faire plaisir à Lucia lors de sa sortie prochaine.
Chapitre : Chapitre 1 (Un goût de paradis) Mission : 4 sur 22 Mission précédente : Aux armes Mission suivante : Frais de labo Lieu : Coastal Auto Care à Key Lento Edition Ultime : Pensez à récupérer le style Rétro pour le Vapid Granado Faire réparer le véhicule Cette nouvelle mission est assez courte et a pour objectif de vous montrer les possibilités de personnalisation et de réparation des véhicules dans GTA 6 . Pour débuter, rejoignez le garage Coastal Auto Care avec la Ganado de Jason. Cette Ganado est en réalité le véhicule personnel de Jason, celui que vous garderez quoi qu’il en coûte et que vous devrez utiliser à de nombreuses reprises. Mais celle-ci aurait bien besoin d’un petit coup de rafraîchissement que vous pensez qui plaira à Lucia.
Une fois arrivé à destination, entrez dans l’atelier pour rencontrer Joey, le mécanicien, qui sera aussi votre contact en cas de dépannage ou de réparation suite à une destruction. Celui-ci vous proposera plusieurs interventions, à commencer par réparer intégralement le moteur de la Ganado. Cette opération est exceptionnellement gratuite pendant cette mission, vous n’avez donc pas besoin de dépenser d’argent pour remettre votre véhicule en état.
Vous devrez ensuite choisir une nouvelle peinture pour votre voiture. Plusieurs couleurs sont disponibles et vous pouvez sélectionner celle qui vous plaît, sans aucune incidence sur la progression de l’histoire, et notamment le style Rétro si vous avez acquis l’édition Ultime.
Une fois les modifications terminées, quittez l’atelier pour retrouver votre liberté et partir à la quête de nouvelles missions dont « Frais de labo » et « Attention indésirable » si ce n’est pas déjà fait, sinon optez pour « Plomberie « . articles.t: How to Switch Characters in GTA 6 – When Jason and Lucia Switching Unlocks
articles.chapeau: Find out how to switch between Jason and Lucia in GTA 6, when character switching unlocks, and which buttons to press on PS5 and Xbox.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google In Grand Theft Auto VI , you can switch between Jason and Lucia as you progress through the story. However, the feature is locked during certain parts of the game, and it takes a while to unlock in the first place. Here’s how to switch characters in GTA 6 , when the feature unlocks, and when you can start playing as Lucia.
To switch characters in GTA 6 , hold right on the D-pad, then press R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox Series X|S. This lets you swap to the other protagonist once you’ve unlocked the feature in Chapter 2.
You’ll likely spend your first 10 hours in Grand Theft Auto VI without free character switching. Some players may take closer to 20 hours to unlock it, depending on how much time they spend exploring and doing optional activities in GTA 6 Chapter 1 .
You unlock free character switching in GTA 6 after completing the “Coffee Break” mission in Chapter 2. The mission starts at the Starlet Motel right after “Breakfast Run.” Once you finish it, you can switch freely between Jason and Lucia in the open world.
You can start free roaming as Lucia after “What’s in the Bag?”, the first mission in Chapter 2. You technically play as her before that during “Discharge Time,” the final mission of Chapter 1. Once you reach Chapter 2, you’ll spend the next couple of hours playing as Lucia solo, depending on how quickly you progress through the story.
Eventually, Jason rejoins Lucia in the story. You’ll be able to swap between them once you finish “Coffee Break.”
There are certain moments in the story when you can’t switch characters in GTA 6 . Without getting into spoilers, some missions require you to play as either Jason or Lucia. Sometimes the other character can also be unavailable in free roam while exploring the Leonida map , which is why their option is grayed out in the character switching menu.
This can happen while you’re at home, so try stepping outside and opening the menu again. If you’re already out in the open world, you may need to wait until the other character is available again. You can also try saving and reloading your game to force the feature to become available.

articles.chapeau: The administration has used Title IX investigations and the possibility of federal enforcement in disputes with school systems.
articles.txt:

The U.S. Department of Education (ED) has invoked the blockbuster video game " Grand Theft Auto 6" to promote the Trump administration 's opposition to transgender athletes competing in women's and girls' sports.
"If it's not allowed in Vice City, it shouldn't be allowed here," the department wrote on X on Saturday afternoon, referencing the game's Miami-inspired fictional setting.
The post included a screenshot of a Google search AI overview that read, "No, Grand Theft Auto VI does not feature gender-segregated sports leagues where a character can join a girls’ team.”
Rockstar Games said "Grand Theft Auto 6" generated $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales after selling 32.5 million units ahead of its release, surpassing the launch of its predecessor, "Grand Theft Auto V," which has sold more than 230 million copies worldwide since 2013.
Newsweek reached out to the ACLU and Rockstar Games, the creator of "GTA 6," and the ED by email for comment Saturday.
Meanwhile, the social media post comes amid an escalating federal and state dispute over Title IX , the 1972 federal civil rights law that prohibits sex-based discrimination in federally funded education programs. The Trump administration contends that allowing transgender girls and women to compete in female athletic categories violates Title IX , and it has pursued schools and districts over their policies with investigations and the threat of withholding federal funds.
Transgender athletes and civil rights advocates have challenged such restrictions in court, arguing that excluding students based on gender identity constitutes unlawful discrimination.
Voters in four states also recently approved measures restricting transgender students from competing in school athletics, adding to a patchwork of state-level rules.
Related Story Four States Approve Transgender School Sports Restrictions In February 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to oppose transgender women and girls participating in female sports categories. At the time, the ED said it would prioritize Title IX enforcement against institutions it determined were failing to protect female athletes.
The issue also surfaced during an unrelated policy discussion earlier in the week. Appearing on Fox News on Monday to discuss aging air traffic control infrastructure following a nationwide ground stop, Vice President JD Vance said the administration could work with Democrats to modernize the system if they "set aside the ridiculous obsession with men in women's sports" and focused on affordability and infrastructure.
"These Democrats, they ran on the Trump agenda of 2024," Vance continued. "Let's work together and rebuild American infrastructure. I know the president wants to. I certainly do as well."
Related Story ‘GTA 6’ Could Break Traffic Records—Here’s What the Stats Mean ... Ongoing Transgender Sports Debate The ED's Office for Civil Rights (OCR) has pursued investigations and enforcement actions against school systems over transgender students' participation in sports and access to bathrooms, locker rooms and other facilities.
On March 13, the ED’s OCR concluded that Jefferson County Public Schools in Colorado violated Title IX through policies allowing transgender girls to participate in girls’ sports and access female bathrooms, locker rooms and overnight accommodations based on gender identity.
After the district did not accept the department's proposed resolution agreement, federal officials issued a letter of impending enforcement action in June. The ED gave the district 10 days to comply and said further action could include administrative enforcement, a possible referral to the Justice Department and termination of federal funding. Earlier this month, CBS News reported that the two agreed to "indefinitely pause" pending litigation.
Four Kansas school districts have also faced federal enforcement action.
In April, the ED concluded that Kansas City, Kansas Public Schools and Topeka Public Schools had Title IX violations involving policies allowing students to use female facilities and participate in single-sex athletics based on gender identity.

articles.t: Aux armes GTA 6 : soluce de la mission 3 (Ammu-Nation)
articles.chapeau: Pour se préparer à ses prochaines activités dans GTA 6, Jason doit s’équiper correctement. Cette nouvelle mission vous emmène notamment [...]
articles.txt:
Pour se préparer à ses prochaines activités dans GTA 6 , Jason doit s’équiper correctement. Cette nouvelle mission vous emmène notamment chez Ammu-Nation, où vous pourrez découvrir les premières possibilités d’achat d’armes.
Chapitre : Chapitre 1 (Un goût de paradis) Mission : 3 sur 22 Mission précédente : Partie de pêche Mission suivante : Juste une égratignure Lieu : Key Lento Rien ne peut être manqué Récupérer une autre arme Bienvenue à Key Lanto, votre fief pour les prochaines heures au moins. Cette nouvelle mission sera l’occasion pour Jason de découvrir les Ammu-Nations, ces magasins d’armes, mais aussi de vous préparer aux prochains affrontements à venir avec les Kingfishers qui n’en ont pas fini avec vous.
Pour commencer, dirigez-vous vers la boîte aux lettres située à l’extérieur de votre maison pour récupérer l’argent disponible. Cette action sera importante puisque vous devrez très régulièrement venir récupérer votre paye sera déposée directement à cet endroit puisque vous ne disposez pas encore d’un compte bancaire. L’argent vous sera important pour pouvoir acheter votre arme.
D’ailleurs, il est temps de rejoindre l’Ammu-Nation indiqué sur votre carte. Parlez ensuite au vendeur, qui vous proposera plusieurs armes. Ici, l’objectif est d’acheter une arme longue afin de compléter votre équipement. Vous pouvez notamment choisir entre un fusil à pompe et un fusil tactique. Votre budget étant encore limité à ce stade de l’aventure, le fusil à pompe représente généralement l’option la plus accessible mais il se peut que vous ayez la possibilité d’acheter le fusil tactique, ce choix n’a de toute manière pas d’importance.
Vous aurez aussi à loisir de découvrir les casiers dans lesquels entreposer tout votre arsenal. Une fois votre achat effectué, quittez l’armurerie pour tomber sur trois membres des Kingfishers qui débarquent pour s’en prendre à Jason. Pas le choix ici, vous devez les affronter pour poursuivre. Alors, vous pouvez tester votre nouvelle arme mais une autre option, vous proposant le corps-à-corps, vous permettra d’éviter d’attirer l’attention de la police et une course-poursuite inutile.
Une fois les trois adversaires neutralisés, il sera temps de sortir votre téléphone et d’appeler Donnie pour le prévenir du danger qui rode. La mission sera terminée après cet appel et vous serez quelque peu libre pour visiter le quartier, comme récupérer les loyers de Brian à travers deux missions « Attention indésirable » et « Frais de labo » ou de retrouver le garage Coastal Auto Care pour faire une surprise à Lucia dans la mission « Juste une égratignure « .

articles.t: GTA 6 Leak: Cyberleek Holds Back the One File That Matters - NewsBreak
articles.chapeau: Remember Cyberleek? The Grand Theft Auto VI leaker with a meme coin and a dream claims to have dumped nearly the entire Xbox build of the game on launch da
articles.txt:
Bluffton, OH From movies and tv to the lastest fashion trends and lifestyles. We are your one-stop for everything.
Remember Cyberleek? The Grand Theft Auto VI leaker with a meme coin and a dream claims to have dumped nearly the entire Xbox build of the game on launch day, and says the last missing piece is coming soon. It’s déjà vu, because we’ve been through this song and dance before.
On Oct. 10, Cyberleek tied a full build release to their coin’s market value hitting $30 million. The coin never came close and flamed out within days. This isn’t the first time it has crashed, either: Tom’s Hardware reported that the leaker cashed out roughly $250,000, mostly from accumulated trading fees, in late August, hours before Rockstar’s official gameplay reveal and just before the coin plunged.
That’s a bit like a magician announcing the big reveal and slipping out through the kitchen with the cash register. And what did we get in the meantime? Some Lucia clips picked by a fan poll and requested by basically nobody else, delivered with the energy of a guy who found a loophole in the “no refunds” policy.
Now the target has dropped to $15 million. Cyberleek says the final file is coming Monday, Nov. 23, no matter what, or sooner if the coin hits $15 million first. Half price, like a clearance rack at a Blockbuster that somehow survived into 2026 (OK, one of them did). Nothing says confidence like cutting your own ransom note in half and hoping nobody notices.
According to PC Gamer , Cyberleek says every file has been released except the main executable, from what the leaker calls the “full November 2026 build” of the game. Reports put the download at roughly 200 GB, with several outlets citing 209 GB. If that’s accurate, they’ve handed over the whole pantry and kept the oven. It’s like mailing someone every ingredient for a birthday cake, then standing outside their house holding the matches and asking for a tip.
One important caveat: as of this writing, nobody has confirmed the build is genuine. Everything about the build itself is Cyberleek’s claim. And files claiming to be Cyberleek builds have been linked to malware before, so this isn’t the torrent to get curious about.
Cyberleek’s pitch is that “this community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps.” Fine. Honestly, kind of compelling. I’ve watched grown adults argue about frame rates in a Walmart parking lot, so I understand the stakes. The catch: no working Xbox Series X emulator exists yet, according to Notebookcheck, so “inside a week” is doing a lot of heavy lifting.
GTA 6 has no official PC version, so Cyberleek is pitching emulation of the leaked console build as the way in. And if the Xbox build can’t be made to work, they say they’ll go after a PlayStation 5 build instead, a fallback they call “most likely never required.” Because apparently one console isn’t enough.
According to launch-day reports from PC Gamer and IGN, the meme coin was sitting at roughly $1.8 million to $1.9 million. Reaching $15 million in a few days would take an eightfold jump, the kind of growth you normally only see in a sourdough starter during lockdown, and even those eventually die in the back of the fridge. So the date is the trigger that actually matters: Monday, Nov. 23.
Maybe Cyberleek has the goods. Maybe they have a folder of loading screens and a very vivid imagination. Nobody knows, and my money’s on the second one, but if the build is real, Rockstar has a headache. Either way, we’ll find out soon. Grab some popcorn, and maybe a sturdy lawn chair.

articles.t: GTA 6 Avery Pawn Shop Safe Code: How to Find and Open the Safe | VGC
articles.chapeau: How to find the Avery Pawn safe code…
articles.txt:
During the Hit Avery Pawn robbery, Jason and Lucia can steal jewellery and cash from a pawn shop in Port Gellhorn. They need to do this to generate the $15,000 needed to get to Vice City. However, there’s an additional reward waiting inside the locked safe in the back office.
Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub , featuring beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more.
Unlike some other safes in GTA 6, the GTA 6 Avery Pawn Shop safe code is not the same for everyone. The four-digit combination is randomised, so you’ll need to obtain it from one of the shop’s employees during the robbery.
First, enter Avery Pawn Shop with Jason or Lucia and draw your weapon. Aim at the employees behind the counter to intimidate them.
When you’re aiming at a staff member, press the Square button to threaten them. Do this a few times. After threatening the employee enoug, the option should change from Threaten to Safe Code? Select this option to make the clerk reveal the four-digit combination. The code will be displayed on the side of your screen as you can see in my screenshot above.
If you kill or knock out the employees, there’s no way to get the code.
The safe is located inside the office at the back of Avery Pawn Shop. Head behind the main counter and look for the staff-only entrance. Make your way through the back room and locate the office. There is usually an employee back here that you’ll need to deal with.
Inside, you’ll find the safe beside the desk. Interact with its keypad and enter the four-digit combination provided by the employee. You can also destroy the CCTV footage in here, and turn off the security alarms.

GTA 6 has a hidden warehouse packed with loot worth $14,000
articles.chapeau: Jason's about to make $14,000 without doing a day's honest work. Lucia would be proud 💰
articles.txt:
GTA 6 players can earn around $14,000 by looting a hidden warehouse in Leonida, without completing a single mission. Here's where to find it
When you begin your GTA 6 story, making money doesn't come easy. For the most part, you'll be earning relatively small amounts before working your way up the criminal underworld and making even Scrooge McDuck jealous. Thankfully, you can earn around $14,000 quite early in the game by visiting a hidden location in Leonida, without even completing a mission.
I'm the kind of gamer who loves exploring open worlds to see what's around the next corner or over the next hill. That's how I stumbled across a remote warehouse near Hamlet in GTA VI , packed with valuable loot, including stolen goods, drugs and cash. It's a fantastic way to earn some extra money for Jason, especially if you want to spoil Lucia on her first day out of prison.
So, if you fancy making some easy cash in Rockstar Games ’ highly anticipated entry in its Grand Theft Auto series without getting your hands too dirty, here's where to find the warehouse and how to get your hands on its valuable loot.
The warehouse in question is Apollo Aggregates, located near Hamlet in South Vice-Dale County. It's easy enough to miss if you're simply driving past, but if you're anything like me and enjoy exploring every little corner of the map, it's certainly worth checking out.
Now, this is where things get interesting, because the warehouse is packed with goods that you can sell for a tidy profit. However, don't expect to simply walk inside and find $14,000 lying around. You'll need to collect everything and find someone willing to take it off your hands.
READ MORE: 9 GTA 6 easter eggs we've spotted that you might have missed
The money isn't the only reason to visit, because there are a few other goodies worth keeping an eye out for. Before you make your escape, be sure to have a proper look around. You never know what else you might find.
There are plenty of ways to make money in GTA VI , but stumbling across a warehouse packed with valuable loot is certainly one of my favourite discoveries so far. After all, earning around $14,000 without completing a single mission isn't a bad way to start your criminal career.
Grand Theft Auto VI is out now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

GTA 6 Officially Becomes One of the Lowest-Rated Games of the Year
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6 is still an unprecedented hit among critics, but longtime fans of the series have helped drive its Metacritic score to record lows.
articles.txt:
By Brett Cardaro Published Nov 21, 2026, 2:45 PM EST Brett joined CBR's team in 2022 as a contributor before quickly moving into a staff writer and flex-editor role covering anime, video games and movies. When he’s not ranting about Dragon Ball or The Legend of Zelda, he’s usually producing Lo-Fi beats or reading Wittgenstein. He’s currently in the early stages of developing a narratively-driven RPG for mobile, though he often procrastinates in favor of continuing his quest to reach Diamond Rank with his Zombie World/Eldlich deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel.
Despite its overwhelmingly positive initial critical reception, Grand Theft Auto VI has now become one of the worst-rated games on Metacritic by user score.
Whereas GTA 6 holds a universally acclaimed critical score of 99 (tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for highest-rated ever), it also holds a dismal 5.6 user rating on Metacritic . This makes it tied for the 21st worst-rated game of 2026 in terms of user score at the time of writing.
A man and a woman robbing a jewelry store. The man is smashing a glass display case with the stock of a rifle, while the woman is aiming a pistol at someone out of frame. Image via Rockstar While a lot of this laughably low user score can be chocked up to review-bombing, the harsh reality is that GTA 6 ’s haters don’t just come from its competitors, as would be the case for a game like Ocarina of Time , for example. Instead, the review-bombing for GTA 6 is coming from all directions: whether it be disgruntled long-time fans of the series, internet justice warriors with political agendas (including many calling the story “woke”) or just the classic doom and gloom from parents that comes with any GTA game’s release.
“Woke storylines have none of the biting, satirical, politically incorrect humor found in the series' older games,” says one user reviewer. Another calls the game’s male protagonist, Jason, a “spineless, weak-willed simp and a doormat whose kid was simply taken away and hidden from him.”
These kinds of reviews clearly have a political undertone to them that’s less about the gameplay or fandom wars, and more about GTA 6 ’s cultural impact. After all, this is the biggest, most highly anticipated video game ever , and everyone is talking about it, for better or worse.
However, it’s the review-bombing from legacy fans of GTA that is the most problematic for the game itself. While every game and TV show does get its share of review-bombers from rival fandoms after it reaches a level of success, few tend to see their own fandoms turn against them with as much vitriol as GTA 6 has seen in the past few days.
Close Image Via Rockstar Image Via Rockstar Image Via Rockstar A quick dive into some of the user review scores shows that many are from actual fans who expected something different from the game than what they got. Fans complain that there are “so many bugs,” that the game runs at “30 fps,” and that the game box doesn’t come with a “physical disc.” At least part of this could be due to the lofty expectations of the game, including the near-perfect critical score it received of 99 by 152 outlets.
Fans came to this game expecting perfection, so it makes the tiny, insignificant issues stand out more than they really should. In reality, even many of the outlets that gave the game a perfect 10/10 did so with the caveat that the game isn’t actually perfect.
“The game does suffer from some familiar open-world flaws,” says Gameliner in its 100/100 review of GTA 6 , “but these rarely detract from the overall experience.” Similarly, Eurogamer Poland argues in its 100/100 review that “Technical issues, a 30 fps frame rate, and dips in performance do little to dull the shine of one of the best and most engrossing games of this generation.”
It’s clear that gaming outlets have discovered some of the imperfections that fans are complaining about too, but the game is just too massive and impressive for them to give it anything less than a 10, despite its flaws. Perhaps IGN Brazil explained this apparent disconnect best: “There are games and works that transcend the scores assigned to them in reviews, because reducing them to a single number will never do them justice; and among those works is GTA 6 .”

articles.t: The anonymous hacker Cyberleek releases an Xbox build of 'GTA VI'
articles.chapeau: The leaked build could be used to create a PC port far in advance of Rockstar's own schedule.
articles.txt:
We've been covering the hacker or hackers known as Cyberleek for months now, as they've attempted to profit from releasing footage of Grand Theft Auto VI well in advance of the official launch date. In that time, Cyberleek dropped a manifesto (the " CYBERLEEK Edict ") championing consumer rights while simultaneously launching and cashing out on a meme coin (named $CYBERLEEK, of course) before disappearing into the void.
Many people assumed that once the game was fully released, we would see the last of Cyberleek, who was thought to possess only an early build of the game. But the pesky leaker, having already avoided all of Take-Two Interactive's attempts to unmask him , is back with an even larger threat. On the Cyberleek website (which we won't link to for legal reasons), Cyberleek claims to have posted a 209 GB Xbox build of GTA VI : "It is done. CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI , and it is going out by torrent." The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile
But, as always with Cyberleek, there is a catch. The download does not include the executable, so the game isn't playable from those files, though. Reddit users have posted what they say are assets from the leak . Cyberleek is threatening to release the executable on Nov. 23. "The countdown is the timer for the final file. Zero, and the executable drops, no conditions. Unless the CYBERLEEK token reaches 15 million market cap first — then it drops immediately."
Because the game is already available for download on Xbox, you might be wondering why Rockstar Games should feel threatened. Cyberleek claims PC modders could use the leaked build to run the game through emulation. Cyberleek, again: "This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons."
In other words,Cyberleek is now claiming fans could get GTA VI running on PC before Rockstar releases an official port.

articles.t: When Do You Leave The Motel in GTA 6? Chapter Three Apartment, Explained
articles.chapeau: The motel isn't exactly the nicest accommodation in GTA 6. When can you leave the motel and move in somewhere a little better? Find out here.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 follows the same operating model as Red Dead Redemption 2. For each new chapter, you’ll move to a new location. In Chapter One, you’ll be at Jason’s safehouse in Key Lento. In Chapter Two, you relocate to a motel in Kelly County, near Port Gellhorn. But in Chapter Three, things change dramatically , and you head into Vice City.
This is when you land in your first ‘apartment’ in Leonida, even if it’s a run-down loaner that leaves a lot to be desired. In this guide, I’ll help you figure out when you can leave the motel in GTA 6, because even though Linda is a charming individual , it’s hardly a place to call home for too long.
You’ll get your new apartment in GTA 6, located square in the middle of Vice City, at the end of Chapter Two and the beginning of Chapter Three. Once you’ve completed the mission ‘Checking Out’, you’ll head to Vice City to connect with Dre’Quan, who will subsequently introduce you to Boobie Ike, whom you might recognize from the earlier marketing materials.
Boobie has an apartment that you can stay in until you’re on your feet again, but it’s not exactly a luxurious spot .
In terms of the overall story percentage, you’ll make your way to the new apartment in Vice City when you’re around 39% complete. There’s still plenty of life left in the game at this point.

articles.t: GTA 6 PC : un pirate affirme pouvoir rendre le jeu jouable en une semaine grâce à une fuite Xbox
articles.chapeau: À peine sorti sur PS5 et Xbox, GTA 6 agite déjà la scène PC : le hacker Cyberleek promet un port jouable en une semaine grâce à une fuite Xbox. Entre build incomplète, memecoin et pression sur Rockstar, cette promesse intrigue autant qu’elle inquiète.
articles.txt:
À peine sorti sur PS5 et Xbox, GTA 6 agite déjà la scène PC : le hacker Cyberleek promet un port jouable en une semaine grâce à une fuite Xbox. Entre build incomplète, memecoin et pression sur Rockstar, cette promesse intrigue autant qu’elle inquiète.
Depuis la sortie de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S, beaucoup se demandent encore quand la version PC arrivera. Un pirate qui se fait appeler Cyberleek promet d’abréger l’attente en rendant GTA 6 PC jouable en « moins d’une semaine » grâce à une fuite Xbox.
Dans un message du 19 novembre relayé par PC Gamer, le hacker affirme : « CL détient la build complète de novembre 2026 de Grand Theft Auto VI, et elle part en torrent, maintenant ». Il décrit une build de développement Xbox d’environ 209 Go et annonce un compte à rebours jusqu’au 23 novembre pour lâcher le fichier clé.
Selon les premiers retours de la scène sécurité comme VX‑Underground , les fichiers ressemblent à de vrais assets de Grand Theft Auto VI : textures, sons, scripts, données du moteur. Mais l’archive Xbox serait privée de son exécutable principal, le fameux .exe qui sert de chef d’orchestre. Sans lui, ces 209 Go restent un puzzle impossible à lancer.
C’est ce fichier que Cyberleek promet de publier, en expliquant qu’il s’agit « d’une build Xbox, pas d’une build PC » mais que « cette communauté l’aura émulée en moins d’une semaine, au‑delà de 30 fps ». Pour l’instant, rien ne prouve que l’exécutable soit réellement en sa possession.
Derrière la promesse de GTA 6 PC rapide se cache aussi un objectif financier. Le pirate lie la mise en ligne anticipée de l’exécutable au succès de son jeton crypto $CYBERLEEK : il réclame 15 millions de dollars, soit environ 14 millions d’euros de capitalisation, après un premier seuil à 30 millions de dollars, près de 28 millions d’euros, jamais atteint.
Sur le plan technique, cette promesse fait tiquer les spécialistes. Aucun émulateur Xbox Series X|S public ne sait aujourd’hui lancer un jeu aussi lourd que GTA 6 . Même avec le kit Xbox GDK , proche de Windows, il faudrait soit émuler tout l’environnement console, soit recompiler le code vers un exécutable PC, ce qui demande d’ordinaire des mois de travail.
Cette agitation attire déjà de faux sites « GTA 6 PC gratuit » et des launchers piégés par des malwares. Télécharger ces builds reste illégal en France, avec à la clé risques de poursuites et de vol de données.
Officiellement, Rockstar Games n’a toujours pas annoncé de version PC de Grand Theft Auto VI , même si des rumeurs évoquent un lancement début 2027 . L’ancien directeur technique Obbe Vermeij estime qu’un portage PC plus rapide serait dans l’intérêt du studio pour couper l’herbe sous le pied des ports sauvages dopés aux outils automatisés et des hackers comme Cyberleek .
En attendant une annonce officielle, la seule manière légale de profiter de GTA 6 sur un écran d’ordinateur reste le streaming de sa version PS5 ou Xbox via Remote Play ou Xbox Cloud Gaming. Entre menaces de leak, chantage au memecoin et protection juridique agressive de Rockstar, la promesse d’un GTA 6 PC jouable en une semaine tient plus du pari risqué que d’une feuille de route crédible.

articles.t: GTA 6 Leak Tied to $15 Million Crypto Goal as Pirated Build Spreads — BigGo Finance
articles.chapeau: An anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek has distributed a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 by torrent while withholding the main…
articles.txt:
Add preferred source An anonymous leaker known as Cyberleek has distributed a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 by torrent while withholding the main executable needed to attempt a PC port. The file is promised for Nov. 23, but would be released early if the CYBERLEEK meme coin reaches a $15 million market cap - down from an earlier $30 million target. The token was trading near $0.002 at a value of about $1.3 million, far short of the goal, and has drawn accusations of a pump-and-dump scheme. None of the files has been verified, Rockstar has announced no PC version, and security researchers report thousands of malware detections tied to fake GTA 6 downloads. Key Elements Cyberleek GTA 6 Rockstar Games CYBERLEEK token Grand Theft Auto PC Gamer Kaspersky GameStop PlayStation 5 Xbox A figure using the handle Cyberleek has posted what is described as a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto 6 to torrent networks, but is holding back the one file that matters most to anyone hoping to run the game on a computer: the main executable.
According to PC Gamer, the leaker has attached a financial condition to that final piece. Cyberleek says the executable will be published on Nov. 23 either way, but will be released early if the CYBERLEEK meme coin reaches a $15 million market capitalization - half the $30 million threshold floated in October.
The market has not cooperated. The token was changing hands near $0.002 over the weekend, putting its value at roughly $1.3 million, or more than $13 million below the stated trigger. It has shed about 20% over the past week, though pricing on a micro-cap asset with very little liquidity can swing violently in either direction.
The missing executable is the piece that would allow modders to begin the work of recompilation - adapting console code so it runs on PC hardware - potentially delivering a playable version long before Rockstar Games plans to sell one. The leaker has said the process could take about a week once the file is available, and has also claimed to hold a PlayStation 5 build as a fallback should the Xbox files prove unusable.
None of the leaked material has been independently verified as authentic, and Rockstar has announced no PC version of the game. The publisher, which has a long record of litigating against leaks and cheats, could pursue legal action rather than tolerate a port.
Skepticism has been loud. Critics have described the arrangement as a shakedown or, worse, an attempt to inflate the coin ahead of a rug pull - the crypto maneuver in which a token's backers abandon it after attracting buyers.
Note: Market figures reflect thin trading in a small-cap token and can change sharply.
The episode lands at the intersection of three trends that have been converging all year: crypto speculation, game piracy and AI-assisted coding. Modern Xbox titles are architecturally closer to PC software than PlayStation releases, which shortens the path to a workable port, and AI programming tools have sped up the decompilation work that such conversions require.
It also extends a turbulent launch window for Grand Theft Auto 6. Crypto traders have repeatedly tried to profit from the game's release, including one who captured about $66,000 amid confusion over ticker symbols. The title's digital-only, disc-free format has separately drawn criticism, with GameStop's chief executive arguing that all-digital games have hurt consumers.
The leak has arrived alongside a wave of fraudulent downloads. Security firm Kaspersky has logged 27,416 detections of GTA 6-related malware and unwanted software since June, according to ZDNET, with fake PC versions ranging from crude AI-generated clones to files designed to hijack machines for crypto mining or to steal personal data. The only official release remains the PlayStation 5 edition; PC players can currently stream it through Sony's Remote Play app.
Rockstar's habit of staggering platforms is central to the frustration driving interest in the leak. Red Dead Redemption 2 reached PC about a year after consoles, and Grand Theft Auto 5 took nearly two years.
For the industry, the stakes go beyond one title. If major new releases can be played free on other platforms within days of launch, publishers lose revenue that funds subsequent development - a threat that falls hardest on smaller studios. The likely defensive response would be tighter always-online requirements, which tend to inconvenience paying customers most.

articles.txt:
CyberLeek has reportedly uploaded more than 200 GB of GTA VI XBOX game files online, but there is still one important file missing from the release: the main executable.
The files first appeared online on November 19, shortly after GTA VI’s launch. The package reportedly contains a large portion of the game’s Xbox development files, but without the executable, users cannot properly access or run the game.
According to Rockstar Games community researcher Lucas7yoshi , the uploaded files are indeed from an XBOX build of GTA VI. However, he pointed out that this is an older version of the game, as it does not even include the separate censorship version for Australia and New Zealand.
More importantly, the game’s assets are encrypted with a key obtained from the main executable. This means that simply downloading the files is not enough to access their contents.
CyberLeek initially announced that the missing executable would be released on November 23, regardless of whether its cryptocurrency reached a certain market value.
However, the group also introduced a condition that could make the release happen earlier. The original target was a $15 million market cap for its CYBERLEEK token. This requirement has since reportedly been lowered to $6 million.
According to GTA community member PLTytus , the token currently has a market cap of around $1.44 million. He also reminded followers that CyberLeek had promised to release the executable once its poll ends on Monday at 6 PM CET, even if the market cap target is not reached.
This means November 23 could be an important date for anyone following the situation, although there is still no independent confirmation that the missing file will actually be released as promised.
One of CyberLeek’s biggest claims is that the community could get the XBOX build running on PC within a week, potentially achieving performance above 30 FPS. However, this is far from guaranteed.
The uploaded files are from an XBOX version of GTA VI, not a native PC build. Even if the missing executable becomes available, getting the game running on PC would require additional work from developers and the emulation community.
For now, there is no confirmed playable PC version coming from this leak, and Rockstar Games has not announced a PC release date. It is also worth remembering that the authenticity and completeness of the entire package have not been independently established.
We will have to wait and see whether CyberLeek actually releases the missing executable on November 23 and what the community manages to do with the files afterward. articles.t: GTA 6: PC gamers welcome unofficial PC port despite potential damage to the industry
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is finally here, but PC gamers are still waiting – at least for an official release. An unofficial PC version could already be on the way. Despite the potential damage such recompilations could do to the gaming industry, the prospect has been met with largely positive reactions online.
articles.txt:
On the day GTA 6 launched, hacker Cyberleek released large portions of the Xbox version , potentially paving the way for an unofficial PC port. The process in question is known as recompilation, which involves adapting a game's code to run on another platform. Cyberleek believes modders could get the game running on PC within a week. On Reddit , the otherwise controversial hacker is receiving plenty of support – despite the potential harm such releases could cause to game developers.
PC gamers are clearly frustrated about having to wait for GTA 6 . However, the enthusiasm surrounding the prospect of an unofficial PC version arriving so soon appears to be driven largely by resentment toward Rockstar's long-standing strategy of releasing its games on consoles first and PC later. Many users accuse Rockstar of deliberately encouraging players to buy the same game twice. Those eager to play GTA 6 at launch may purchase the console version, only to buy it again on PC later to enjoy improved graphics. Some commenters have even openly stated that they intend to play the unofficial port. Others hope that rapid progress on the recompilation will put pressure on Rockstar to bring forward the official PC release.
Whether the unofficial port will actually be playable next week remains uncertain. Modders are still missing a crucial file: the game's executable (EXE), without which it cannot be launched. Cyberleek says he plans to release it on November 23, but whether that will be enough to produce a working PC version so quickly remains to be seen. There are also broader concerns about the potential consequences of such recompilations. If newly released games become available for free on other platforms shortly after launch, developers could lose valuable revenue. For smaller studios in particular, those losses could threaten their survival. Over time, this could make it harder to finance new games and encourage publishers to introduce stricter always-online requirements – ultimately leaving players worse off as well.

articles.t: GTA 6 Quietly Mocks an Infamous Donald Trump Florida Moment
articles.chapeau: Rockstar said it wouldn't directly satirize Trump — but GTA 6 takes a shot anyway
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 takes place in Rockstar Games' fictional version of Florida, so many wondered how the game might tackle President Donald Trump, who spends much of his time at his private club, Mar-a-Lago. Prior to release, Rockstar dispelled any notion that the game might directly address the current President of the United States. Doing so might make the game feel dated, according to Rockstar North studio head Rob Nelson. Now that the game is out, fans have discovered that GTA 6 does quietly acknowledge Trump.
The Easter egg probably isn't what you're expecting, and it doesn't really mention the Republican President's controversial politics. The shout-out does, however, poke fun at Trump's infamy for allegedly skipping out on the bill. You may have already seen it without realizing what it is. The story is a hyper-localized one involving a 2023 Trump visit to Miami's iconic Cuban restaurant, Versailles.
According to the Miami New Times , Trump came to the restaurant after being arraigned at a Miami courthouse over allegations of retaining government secrets and conspiring to obstruct justice. When he arrived at the restaurant, there was a crowd — and they were so ecstatic to see him that they began singing "Happy Birthday" to him. His birthday was technically the next day, and the man had just been indicted on 37 federal charges , but it didn't matter. The fans evidently wanted to express their love for the politician/reality TV show host in some way.
Trump gladly lapped up the attention and responded by declaring there would be "food for everyone!" The crowd cheered: They thought Trump was implying he was going to pick up their tab.
You're never going to believe this , but Trump did not, in fact, purchase anything for anyone. The Miami New Times reported that the President only stuck around for about 10 minutes before leaving. Since the incident, there's been some debate over whether Trump truly slighted anyone during the visit . He wasn't there for long, so could anyone truly have expected him to pull out his wallet?
However you interpret it, GTA 6 hides a reference to this controversial Florida moment through a small detail in its digital recreation of Versailles. The video game version of the establishment is called Antoinette, but the restaurant's reputation as a Miami staple and the building's matching exteriors heavily imply that Antoinette is based on a real-world restaurant. Even the restaurant's proprietors have made this connection.
TikToker Quique took a closer look at the GTA 6 version of the locale and found that there's a flier hanging from one of the windows. It reads: "All government officials must pay before leaving. Thank you." The connection between the real-life incident and GTA 6 's joke seems clear, according to fans from Florida in the TikTok video's comments.
Image: Quique/Tiktok It's a funny reference that reflects Rockstar's dedication to capturing Florida , and Miami in particular, to the fullest possible extent. As far as things go, though, it's a fairly tame Donald Trump moment that won't ruffle many political feathers. For a series known for lampooning American politics, that's kind of disappointing. You can't really extricate Trump from Florida, after all.
Anyway, my favorite part of the whole story is the interviews the Miami New Times conducted with the people who serenaded Trump​​​​​​​ at the restaurant after the President left the premises.
"He's the only one that will fight for us, for you, for me, for the people watching this at home," he said of the encounter, in which the president had arguably failed to keep his promise to the public just minutes earlier.

articles.t: La build de GTA 6 fuiteée par Cyberleak se heurte à un mur : il n'existe pas d'émulateur Xbox Series X|S - Gamereactor France
articles.chapeau: Cyberleak affirme partager en torrent une build Xbox complète de Grand Theft Auto VI et prétend que les joueurs PC pourraient l'émuler en une semaine, mais aucun émulateur Xbox Series X|S fonctionnel n'existe.
articles.txt:
Le groupe de hackers Cyberleak affirme distribuer en torrent une build Xbox complète de Grand Theft Auto VI datant de novembre 2026 et prétend que les joueurs PC pourraient avoir le jeu « émulé en une semaine ». , une promesse qui se heurte de plein front à un mur technique : aucun émulateur Xbox Series X|S fonctionnel n'existe.
Cyberleak a déclaré dans un message du 19 novembre détenir la build Xbox complète et que les fichiers étaient diffusés immédiatement en torrent. Les premiers coups d'œil jetés sur la version par des membres de la communauté des hackers suggèrent qu'elle est authentique mais qu'il manque le fichier .EXE du lanceur nécessaire pour la faire tourner, et Cyberleak affirme que cet exécutable est « verrouillé derrière un compte à rebours » jusqu'au 23 novembre sauf si son jeton crypto atteint d'abord une capitalisation de 15 millions de dollars .
L'archive de logiciels malveillants vx-underground, qui a inspecté le torrent, affirme que les fichiers contiennent de véritables éléments de GTA 6 et que des gens pourraient y jouer sur PC dès lundi si le .exe sort le 23 comme promis.
> wake up > take a shit > get out of bed > check beep boop > over 9000 DMs > "SCHMEELI, GTA VI LEAK" > ??? > sends link > torrent > ok > look inside > actual assets > huh > squint eyes > look closer > not larp huh, how about that. the cyberleek guy released the full xbox gta 6… pic.twitter.com/1MDrGI97Dy
Le calendrier d'une semaine est l'affirmation de Cyberleak elle-même, et elle mérite du scepticisme pour deux raisons. D'abord, le groupe a un historique documenté d'utilisation de fuites précédentes de GTA 6 pour faire monter un programme de cryptomonnaie de 250 000 dollars, donc ses dates annoncées sont mieux traitées comme des affirmations que comme des événements programmés.
Ensuite, et plus fondamentalement, l'émulation est peut-être le mauvais mot pour ce qui suivrait la sortie d'un exécutable. Aucun émulateur Xbox Series X|S fonctionnel n'existe encore, il n'y a donc pas de route toute prête d'une build Xbox extraite vers une version PC jouable. Un portage non officiel fonctionnel dépendrait plutôt d'une recompilation, convertissant le code de la console pour tourner nativement sur PC, un chemin bien plus lent et moins certain que les taux d'images par seconde dont se targue Cyberleak.
GTA 6 est sorti sur console le 19 novembre, et Rockstar n'a annoncé aucune version PC. Des rumeurs évoquent un portage officiel début 2027, et l'ancien directeur technique de Rockstar, Obbe Vermeij, a soutenu que le studio bénéficierait à sortir un portage PC tôt, compte tenu de l'essor des portages assistés par IA. Cyberleak, dont le nom apparaît sous la forme « Cyberleek » dans certains titres repris par la presse, indique que si la version Xbox ne débouche pas sur un portage PC, il se tournerait plutôt vers une version PS5.
Rockstar n'a fait aucune déclaration sur la fuite. Cyberleak affirme que l'exécutable Xbox suivra le 23 novembre, quel que soit le résultat du programme de cryptomonnaie.

articles.t: GTA 6 PC Port Leak: 209 GB Xbox Dump, No Emulator
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 PC port leak: Cyberleek 209 GB Xbox dump lacks its executable, and no Xbox Series X|S emulator exists. What is verified and what is not.
articles.txt:
Image: Rockstar Games The GTA 6 PC port leak story took a sharper turn on November 21, 2026, two days after the console launch. A leaker calling itself Cyberleek says it put a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI into circulation, and XDA Developers reported the claim as an unverified release of a dumped build. Nobody has confirmed the files are real. The reported dump also lacks the main executable, so the game cannot start.
That gap is the whole story. Cyberleek says the community will turn an Xbox build into a PC game within a week, yet reports describe no working Xbox Series X|S emulator that could run it. Our earlier report on the dump covered what appeared on the leaker’s site. This analysis asks a different question: how far is a 209 GB Xbox archive from a playable Windows version, and what do the headlines get right and wrong?
We tie every claim below to a named outlet, and we separate what the reports state from what only the leaker asserts. Rockstar Games has not officially announced a PC port, according to the coverage we reviewed. Everything about a PC route to the game remains speculation for now.

Cyberleek claims to hold a November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI and says it is distributing the archive by torrent. PCMag reported the claim on November 20 and described a download of about 209 GB that the group says contains a decrypted Xbox build. VGTimes added that a link on the group’s site carried a label reading XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026), and that journalists had seen the site itself.
The timing matters. Reports place the post on November 19, the same day the game reached PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. A leak that lands on launch day maximizes attention, and that pattern fits a group that has spent months building an audience around Rockstar’s biggest release.
PCMag also reported that the archive appeared to include files tied to Rockstar’s RAGE engine and Xbox files connected with AMD graphics technology. That detail suggests the listing looks like a real console package, though a convincing file tree proves little by itself. File listings and screenshots are easy to stage, and a name on a folder is not a working game.
Cyberleek also drew a line between this release and a PC release. Its own wording, as quoted by GamesRadar, admitted that this is an Xbox build and not a PC build. We come back to that admission below, because it changes how readers should weigh the PC port framing that dominates search results.
Most of what circulates today is a claim about a claim. Outlets such as PCMag, GameSpot, IGN and Gamereactor UK report that Cyberleek says things, and several note that they could not check the files. The table sorts the main points by how well the coverage supports them.
The pattern is clear. Only two things hold up across outlets: a leaker made public claims, and the reported package cannot launch without a file the leaker withholds. Authenticity sits at the bottom of the confidence scale. The Ma-no.org write-up said Eurogamer could not confirm that the advertised files exist, and The GTA 6 Map reached a similar conclusion in its own coverage.
An executable is the program that loads everything else. Game data, models, audio and scripts sit in archives, and the executable decides how to read them and when to run them. Without it, the 209 GB of reported content is a very large pile of assets with no way to start.
GameSpot reported that the absent executable prevents the build from launching as a playable game. Cyberleek itself describes holding that single file back on a countdown. The group’s framing is that every other file is out and only the launcher is held, a tactic that keeps attention on the story for days.
Assets alone can still interest people. Modelers, datamining communities and analysts can inspect meshes, textures, map files and configuration data if the files are real and readable. That kind of material feeds speculation videos and wiki pages. It does not produce a running game.
A console executable also differs from a Windows one at the instruction and system level. An Xbox title targets a fixed hardware platform and a specific operating environment. articles.txt:
Hacker group Cyberleak says it holds a full Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI and is already leaking it by torrent, a dump that could hand PC players the game before Rockstar Games has even announced one for the platform.
In a November 19 post, Cyberleak wrote that “CL holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is going out by torrent. Now.” The build is missing the main .EXE launcher file, which Cyberleak says is being held on a countdown until November 23, adding that if the Xbox build does not produce a playable PC port, “CL will work to get a PS5 build.” Early looks by members of the hacking community suggest the leaked files are genuine GTA 6 assets, with only the launcher missing.

A leak with a price tag Cyberleak has tied the early release of the launcher to its own crypto token reaching a $15 million market cap, promising a November 23 release regardless, as the threat was first reported on November 20 . That condition is worth treating with suspicion: this is the same group that previously used GTA 6 leaks to pump a $250,000 cryptocurrency scheme. Rockstar Games and its parent Take-Two are also known to pursue people who leak Grand Theft Auto material, and neither has commented on the dump.
GTA 6 is out now and only on consoles, after the delay that pushed its launch to May 2026 , and with Rockstar confirming a download of up to 212GB before release. No PC version has been announced, and rumors point to an official port early in 2027. Former Rockstar technical director Obbe Vermeij has argued that Rockstar would benefit from releasing a PC port early, given the rise of AI-assisted ports, a gap that makes a hacked console build attractive to some players.
Cyberleak claims the community could have the Xbox build emulated on PC within a week and running well past 30 frames per second, but no working Xbox Series X/S emulators exist yet, which casts doubt on that timeline. The malware archive vx-underground, which independently inspected the torrent and found actual game assets with the launcher missing, says an emulated PC version could follow within days of the .EXE appearing.
Everything about the dump rests on Cyberleak’s own statements, and the group’s past behavior suggests the financial incentive behind the leak matters more than any release schedule. The launcher is promised for November 23, a Monday, with Cyberleak saying it drops on that date whether or not the token reaches its target.
